result.notes: Menu is bilingual German/English. Drinks and desserts were skipped; the 40-dish cap meant favouring mains, bowls, salads and noodle dishes. Protein-variant dishes list only some variants (chicken, beef, salmon, tofu), and duck and tuna variants are omitted. Starters were limited to Crispy Pork Belly, Pearl Island and the Skewers Plate. All figures are estimates for typical Berlin portions, with rice about 200 g cooked and noodles about 200-250 g cooked.
